I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It compiles with `wj build` and runs correctly on my test input.

I ran it with `wj run --compiled`. It matched both examples (`60 Monday`, `2 Monday`, `0 Sunday`, `invalid`). It also printed `invalid` for `2023-02-29 2023-01-01`, and it skipped the blank line. I didn't test other inputs, such as years outside 1900–2100 or lines with extra tokens.
